title: Thinking on Making Better Decisions
summary: Kahran and Divya open with the problem that the more committed you get to one path the harder it feels to start over — even though six users could have just been onboarded fresh. They get into sunk-cost weight, deductive vs inductive reasoning, Bezos picking books because the web was growing 2300 percent, and how Divya treats writing as inevitability rather than vision.
topics: why pivots feel impossible once you have assets
asking what could happen vs what will happen
making changes inside a bigger company
moving country vs learning a language analogy

intents.display: to think through decision-making when sunk cost and inertia are loud
